changes: Extracted the inline stylesheet and runtime into app.css and app.js, removing six levels of container indentation while keeping the source in readable, non-minified form.
Kept the page HTML focused on semantic reading order: claim, network figure, fallback, evidence column, and source note are now visible without crossing a 600-line style block.
Removed CSS for the absent data-stamp and reset kbd elements, an absent conclusion pseudo-element, two unused color tokens, and visually redundant default declarations.
Factored one entityId helper for D3's string-or-mutated-object link endpoints, so selection logic and link-opacity logic share the same explicit normalization rule.
Made the existing 28-row renderer fallback keyboard focusable and scrollable through PageUp/PageDown/Home/End and the mouse wheel while preserving its unfocused first frame pixel-for-pixel.

chart_contract.claim: Two generalist pollinators bridge the two plant communities because each has recorded visit edges to plants on both sides; the other six pollinators have no cross-community plant edges.
chart_contract.renderer: D3 SVG with seeded, manually settled force layout
chart_contract.layout_algorithm: Seed 0xB10D1E for starting jitter; D3 force random source 0x5E771E; forceLink, charge, collide, x and y forces; alphaDecay .0228, velocityDecay .48; exactly 340 manual ticks, then stop and clamp.

pixel_comparison.method: Playwright Chromium screenshots at fixed state; normal full view settled for 360 ms, reduced states updated directly; PIL absolute pixel difference.

inputs.mouse: full/bridge controls, evidence entity, SVG entity, reset: pass
inputs.keyboard: 1, 2, R, Escape, SVG focus, Enter: pass
inputs.touch: view control and SVG entity tap: pass
inputs.rapid_input: full -> bridge -> full -> local -> plant settles at {view: full, selected: plant-clover}

fallback.trigger: D3 script fulfilled with an empty successful response
fallback.first_row: 白尾熊蜂 / 红三叶 / 林缘 / 32 次
fallback.last_row: 银纹夜蛾 / 欧当归 / 湿草甸 / 26 次

cross_audit.scope: Independent second audit of formal immutability, author metrics, readability, topology, deterministic force layout, four viewport/motion combinations, fixed states, real inputs, reset, resize, fallback, pagehide disposal and reload.
cross_audit.candidate_author_changes: none; the candidate author layer already met the readable-compact and zero-degradation contract
cross_audit.assessment: pass; no visual, animation, interaction, data, deterministic-layout or lifecycle degradation found

rejected_high_risk_reductions: Do not encode the 16 nodes or 28 edges as opaque tuples merely to save repeated property names; the canonical records are the sample's learnable evidence layer.
Do not precompute node coordinates or remove the seeded 340-tick force construction; the real deterministic network layout is a required part of the sample.
Do not remove local edges, low-opacity context, node labels, link titles, focus paths, evidence totals, status prose, or the 28-row fallback.
Do not merge bridge/full/selected state into direct SVG mutations or remove stable IDs and keyed D3 joins.
Do not change force parameters, scale domain, curve geometry, visit values, split precision, transition duration, opacity rules, or reset reconstruction.
Do not minify D3-facing code, shorten semantic record fields into cryptic aliases, or replace the SVG relation with a static image.
